reddit.title: Improved Music Transition in Provincia
reddit.body: We've made a significant update to how music transitions in Provincia. Instead of hard cuts, our audio system now utilizes a smooth crossfade for day, night, title, and combat beds. This change ensures a seamless experience without the jarring interruptions that were previously noticeable. Check out the full details here: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=reddit&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops

steam.title: Music Transition Improvements
steam.body: We're excited to announce that we've improved the music transitions in Provincia! Our new audio system eliminates hard cuts and instead uses a smooth crossfade between day, night, title, and combat beds. This enhancement ensures a more immersive and enjoyable experience as you build and manage your colony. For more details, check out our latest devtalk: https://provincia.ch/devtalk/soft-music-reloops?utm_source=steam&utm_medium=social&utm_campaign=soft-music-reloops
